[[File:Gizmo Bilt.png|thumb|250px|Gizmo Bilt]] '''Gizmo''' (Japanese: '''ヤバシ''' ''Yabashi'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[JN078|Detective Drizzile!]]''. His full name is '''Gizmo Bilt''' (Japanese: '''ヤバ・ヤバシ''' ''Yabashi Yaba''). ==In animation== ===History=== Gizmo had his {{p|Kecleon}} infiltrate [[Cerise Laboratory]] so that he could delete all the data that {{Ash}} and [[Goh]] had collected during their adventures. Despite [[Professor Cerise]] taking precautions to stop it from happening again, Gizmo was able to find out the codes to unlock the data with the help of Kecleon. One night, Goh spotted what was going on with the help of his {{p|Drizzile}} and was able to corner Kecleon before Gizmo revealed himself. Kecleon was defeated when Drizzile [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{TP|Goh|Inteleon}}. Gizmo attempted to flee to Kecleon, only to be stopped by Inteleon's {{m|Snipe Shot}}. When Professor Cerise arrived, Gizmo was excited to see him. Ash and Goh were shocked to see that Gizmo was just a fanboy who had just wanted to get the professor's attention. Upon learning that the data wasn't permanently lost, Professor Cerise gave Gizmo the autograph he had desired. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Gizmo's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Gizmo |pkmn=Kecleon |gender=female |type1=Normal |img=Gizmo Kecleon.png |epnum=JN078 |epname=Detective Drizzile! |vajp=Risa Shimizu |vaen=Cherami Leigh |desc={{p|Kecleon}} is Gizmo's only known Pokémon. Using her ability to turn invisible, Kecleon was able to infiltrate [[Cerise Laboratory]] so that Gizmo could hack into its system, allowing him to delete all the data that had been collected by {{Ash}} and [[Goh]]. When Goh realized what was going on, Kecleon battled his {{p|Drizzile}}, only to be defeated when it [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{TP|Goh|Inteleon}}. Kecleon's known moves are {{m|Sucker Punch}}, {{m|Bind}}, and {{m|Iron Tail}}, and her [[Ability]] is {{a|Color Change}}.}} ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=高城元気 ''Motoki Takagi'' |en=[[Lori Phillips]] |fr_eu=Ludivine Deworst |he=מייה קדוש ''Mia Kadosh'' |it=Patrizia Mottola |pt_br=Cassio Alves |es_eu=Sara Vivas |es_la=Carlo Vázquez |ca=Cristal Barreyro }} ==In the manga== [[File:Gizmo Bilt JNM.png|thumb|200px|Gizmo in {{ma|Pokémon Journeys}}]] ===Pokémon Journeys=== Gizmo appeared in ''[[JNM22|Detective Drizzile!]]'', serving an identical role as in the eponymous episode. ====Pokémon==== {| style="float:left; width: 96px" |- | {{ActivePoké|Gizmo|Kecleon|Gizmo Kecleon JNM.png|size=x200px|normal|link=no}} ♀ | | |}{{-}} ==Trivia== * In the Japanese version, Gizmo usually ends his sentences and laughs with "{{tt|し|shi}}", playing on his name. * In the {{pmin|Italy|Italian}} [[dub]], he shares his voice actor with another mechanic inventor, {{an|Sophocles}}. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background: #{{normal color light}}; border: 3px solid #{{normal color dark}}" !
